notes: Measured on AE 2026 8 bpc, straight 8-bit colour, HLS with L = (max + min)/2: Hue (degrees) = HLS hue rotation keeping max and min; Saturation = HLS S * (1 + Sat/100) clamped to 1 (= chroma scaled about L); Lightness > 0 blends the RGB towards white (c + (1 - c) Lt), < 0 towards black (c (1 + Lt)), Lt = Light/100 -- not an HLS L shift: dark colours lose chroma too (an HLS-L model is off by up to 21/255). One rounding with exact .5 ties DOWN (Lightness +30: black -> 76.5 -> 76): color_balance_hls_1 bit-exact. Residual: with a hue rotation, results landing exactly on .5 (e.g. +90 on (255, v, 0) gives 127.5 - v) are rounded up or down by AE in a pattern that follows its own float arithmetic (neither half-up, half-down, half-even nor the f32/f64 formulas tried reproduce it): 25 % of opaque pixels +-1 on color_balance_hls_0 (max 1). Saturation > 0 and Lightness < 0 have no visible reference.
